channel.title: Comments for page "Life Saver"
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Life Saver"

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Yeah, thought the same. He improvised to scare the dude from jumping. But like…it was a wrong move. There's 50/50 chance when you say what this guy said. Like…do you really expect someone with severe depression to care about what will happen? Do you really expect someone you don't know cares? I'm saying this from my point of view, because if it were me on that roof, I'd jump just to do the opposite of what the stranger is trying to make me do. You know "cut off the nose to spite your face." And I think there are other people like me, who are willing to hurt themselves in the long run just to prove somebody wrong.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Is it weird to say that this doesn't sound like a psychopath, and more like a really jaded dude really not wanting this guy to kill himself? I mean, after saying something like that to a guy, do you really expect him to still jump?

Seems like just an asshole giving someone some perspective on life in a weird, twisted way. Like all I can imagine if the guy did jump is this guy going "Aw shit, really didn't expect that."

That really comes in the line "Why would you care? You're dead."

> You have reached the Charles Manson suicide prevention hotline. All our operators are busy plotting to kill everyone you've ever known if you go through with it. So, go ahead.

I'm not really sure if this belongs here, but it was too odd not to bring to folks attention. The person in question is a friend of a friend, and is happy to tell the story to just about anyone after a drink or two. I don't have any real reason to doubt him, but lordy it's weird.

As for the actual content…it's insane, yes, brutal, yes….but it'd hard to argue with results.
